body:
Closes #15 (phase A). Status files for 7 accepted kit specs (index, overview, quality, remote, roles, skills, templates; 39 criteria), created with `octo-feather-spec-status init bfb3a92`, then one `just qc` per spec with all its ids; only passes flip to built (ADR 0021, ADR 0022). Status-only lane: no code, spec or contract edits. No status files for comms or issue-lifecycle (phase B, after #8). Baseline qc failures are product gaps, not factory findings (owner, 2026-10-19); they open gap lanes, never a correction lane. ## Acceptance evidence Owner OK (Tom, 2026-10-19): all 7 specs accepted at `bfb3a92` by Accept spec hand-offs in `~/src/octo-feather-specs/docs/specs/*.review/human`: | spec | hand-off id | |---|---| | index | hmvfhi5rk2m7o | | overview | hmvfh43ue4fd5 | | quality | hmvfhgeobgadj | | remote | hmvfhhppmukzq | | roles | hmvfhdo9o58jg | | skills | hmvfhh2kyosi7 | | templates | hmvfhi1yv0mhw | `octo-feather-accepted` cannot confirm them (finding 13, later fix lane); not run as a gate. Spec HTML is byte-identical to `bfb3a92` (`git diff --quiet bfb3a92 HEAD -- docs/specs/`). ## QC results (20/39 built, all pr 16) | run | spec | passed | seconds | judged head | qc commit | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | overview | 0/4 | 98 | b3aee7a | none (all fail) | | 2 | index | 1/1 | 88 | b3aee7a | 01d86a3 | | 3 | skills | 2/5 | 255 | 01d86a3 | 2574951 | | 4 | templates | 5/6 | 269 | 2574951 | e4a04c3 | | 5 | quality | 2/7 | 201 | e4a04c3 | 2fbd899 | | 6 | remote | 1/7 | 125 | 2fbd899 | 764c710 | | 7 | roles | 9/9 | 348 | 764c710 | f5f90b8 | Built: index `acceptance-index-links`; skills `acceptance-only-listed` `acceptance-notice`; templates `acceptance-fresh-green` `acceptance-type-error` `acceptance-layer-break` `acceptance-cli-json` `acceptance-target-agents-md`; quality `acceptance-gate-green` `acceptance-public-surfaces`; remote `acceptance-login-gate`; roles all 9 (`acceptance-tab-headless-same` `acceptance-family-guard` `acceptance-unknown-key` `acceptance-unresolved-skill` `acceptance-unknown-model` `acceptance-no-skill-leak` `acceptance-director-tools` `acceptance-supervise-layout` `acceptance-worker-in-lane`). Every commit after b3aee7a is a `just qc` status commit touching exactly one status file; built set equals the reports' pass set. Judge `openai/gpt-6.1-sol`; kit judge files (`octo-feather-qc`, `pi-role`, `code-reviewer.md`, `principle-prove-it-works`) unchanged b65799c..f99279b across all runs. Reports: `~/.local/state/octo-feather/qc/gh15-/.json` (per-slug dir, finding 15). ## Review Fresh code-reviewer (`openai/gpt-6.1-sol`) on f5f90b8 vs b65799c: CLEAR, 0 blocking, 0 notes. Checked: only the 7 status files changed; 39 ids match the spec anchors; accepted_commit bfb3a92; spec HTML unchanged; 20 pass -> built/pr 16, 19 fail -> planned/null; each qc commit touches one status file, its parent is the judged head, its bytes match qc output; `just check` green. ## QC sandbox (finding 17) Runs 1-6: env sandbox. herdr PATH shim `--session qc-sandbox` (headless server), `HERDR_SOCKET_PATH`/`HERDR_BIN_PATH` at the sandbox, `HERDR_SESSION=qc-sandbox`, `XDG_STATE_HOME=/tmp/gh15-state`, `SPEC_CHAT_STATE=/tmp/gh15-state/spec-chat`, empty `GH_CONFIG_DIR`. Verified: shim `workspace list` empty (no director/gh8/gh15), `gh auth status` exit 1, `git ls-remote origin` exit 128, `octo-feather-state` = `/tmp/gh15-state/octo-feather/sessions/qc-sandbox`. Run 6 escape: the judge ran `herdr --session default api snapshot` and read the live session (read-only; live server log shows no mutation from it). Run 7: `unshare -rm` mount namespace (tmpfs over `~/.config/herdr` with only `sessions/qc-sandbox` bound back, tmpfs over `~/.config/gh`) plus a shim that strips `--session/--remote/--machine`. Verified inside: raw `herdr --session default workspace list` = server_not_running (no socket); shim lists only the sandbox; gh auth fails; worktree clean; `pi-role --json agents/code-reviewer.md` ok; model probe ok. The roles judge spawned 7 agent panes and 2 headless pi runs, all in the sandbox and all exited. Credential copies: the skills judge copied `~/.pi/agent/{auth,models}.json` (mode 600) to /tmp to start a headless implementer; removed. Checked after every later run: none. ## Gap list (baseline qc failures; every one stays planned) 1. **overview `acceptance-owner-pr`** - command: `scripts/octo-feather-accepted docs/specs/overview.spec.html --repo /home/exedev/src/octo-feather-gh15` - output: `not accepted: docs/specs/overview.spec.html is not registered with the review service (register it, then Accept spec) Exit: 1` - why: class: unexercised-criterion; kickoff acceptance prerequisite unavailable, so no director-to-owner merge ask, complete lane PR, review verdict or required checks were demonstrated. - note: Exercise limit: sandbox SPEC_CHAT_STATE is an empty registry, so 'not registered'; against real state it fails as 'no row is accepted' (finding 13). 2. **overview `acceptance-retired-words`** - command: `python3 /tmp/overview-qc-b3aee7a/demo.py words` - output: `docs/qc-vocabulary.md: exit=0 refs: ok (100 files) roles: ok (5 role files, reviewer family openai != implementer anthropic) spec-status: ok (7 status files) templates: ok (2) just check: ok` - why: class: validation-gap; in a throwaway copy, tracked docs/qc-vocabulary.md called the top agent operator and the person human, but the entire gate passed without the required correction message. 3. **overview `acceptance-pi-only`** - command: `python3 /tmp/overview-qc-b3aee7a/demo.py pi` - output: `CLAUDE.md: exit=1 CLAUDE.md check-refs: Claude/Codex projection files above are not allowed (docs/adr/0001) error: Recipe 'check-refs' failed with exit code 1 .codex/AGENTS.md: exit=1 .codex/AGENTS.md check-refs: Claude/Codex projection files above are not allowed (docs/adr/0001) error: Recipe 'chec [...]` - why: class: incomplete-diagnostic; empty tracked instruction files were rejected, but neither diagnostic named Pi as the only runtime. 4. **overview `acceptance-portable`** - command: `python3 /tmp/overview-qc-b3aee7a/demo.py portable` - output: `director: model=anthropic/claude-opus-5-5; tools=read,grep,find,ls,bash; skills=2; contract-bytes=13801 supervisor: model=anthropic/claude-opus-5-5; tools=read,grep,find,ls,bash,edit,write; skills=6; contract-bytes=12168 implementer: model=anthropic/claude-opus-5-5; tools=read,grep,find,ls,bash,edit [...]` - why: class: unexercised-criterion; no alternate-runtime launcher was available or implemented, so argument generation does not prove execution of every role or the permitted scope of port edits. 5. **skills `acceptance-patch-only`** - command: `python3 /tmp/gh15-qc/reinstall.py` - output: `All 11 patch headers name ADRs. skillfile install exit=0. tdd DIFF ['agents/openai.yaml', '.meta']; implement DIFF ['agents/openai.yaml', '.meta']; code-review DIFF ['agents/openai.yaml', '.meta']. Ten Matt Pocock skill folders gain agents/openai.yaml absent from the committed folders. All 14 SKILL. [...]` - why: class: vendored-reproduction-drift; text patches reproduce correctly, but fresh installation does not reproduce ten committed skill folders, excluding generated .meta files. 6. **skills `acceptance-skill-frontmatter`** - command: `python3 /tmp/gh15-qc/frontmatter.py; python3 /tmp/gh15-qc/frontmatter-edge.py` - output: `missing-name exit=1 check-skills: .agents/skills/qc-missing/SKILL.md lacks name/description frontmatter missing-description exit=1 check-skills: .agents/skills/qc-missing/SKILL.md lacks name/description frontmatter neither exit=1 check-skills: .agents/skills/qc-missing/SKILL.md lacks name/descriptio [...]` - why: class: unvalidated-frontmatter; the gate accepts a skill with no frontmatter when name/description appear as body text, and accepts empty values. 7. **skills `acceptance-external-skill`** - command: `bash /tmp/gh15-qc/external.sh` - output: `octo-feather-spec-chat: 3 Spec Chat skill links in /tmp/gh15-qc/external-target/.agents/skills, ignored in /tmp/gh15-qc/external-target/.git/info/exclude Supervisor external skills: /tmp/gh15-qc/external-target/.agents/skills/spec-chat-shape, /tmp/gh15-qc/external-target/.agents/skills/spec-chat-rev [...]` - why: class: unexercised-criterion; installation and launch arguments worked, but no revised-spec review link was observed in a director tab, nor was shaping scope verified. - note: Exercise limit: no director tab or review link in the sandbox. 8. **templates `acceptance-same-gate`** - command: `python3 /tmp/templates-qc.liwe5C/probe-gate.py same` - output: `python: agents, installed hook, and push/pull_request CI all name just check; remotes=(none). typescript: agents, installed hook, and push/pull_request CI all name just check; remotes=(none). NOT EXERCISED: hosted push, red CI status, and PR merge blocking; local wiring alone is insufficient.` - why: class: unexercised-ci; wiring matches, but no hosted template-born repository or protected PR was available, and creating or pushing one was outside this read-only run. - note: Exercise limit: no hosted template-born repo or protected PR in a read-only run. 9. **quality `acceptance-gate-no-model`** - command: `t=$(mktemp -d /tmp/quality-model.XXXXXX); git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$t"; python3 -c 'import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); p.write_text(p.read_text().replace("check: check-scripts", "check: qa check-scripts", 1))' "$t/justfile"; (cd "$t" && just [...]` - output: `just qa: not implemented yet (factory evals, docs/future.md) error: Recipe 'qa' failed on line 163 with exit code 2 gate_exit=2` - why: class: gate-model-reachability. Adding qa as a gate dependency executes it before the guard; failure comes from the stub, without the required deterministic-and-free diagnostic. - note: EXPECTED (just qa stub): the stub's own exit 2 fails the gate, not a deterministic-and-free guard. 10. **quality `acceptance-qc-listed`** - command: `gh pr view --json number,url,headRefOid,body,reviews,comments; printf '\nLane state lookup:\n'; scripts/octo-feather-state; git status --short` - output: `To get started with GitHub CLI, please run: gh auth login Alternatively, populate the GH_TOKEN environment variable with a GitHub API authentication token. Lane state lookup: /tmp/gh15-state/octo-feather/sessions/qc-sandbox` - why: class: unverified-merge-ask. GitHub authentication is unavailable, so I could not read a merge ask or verify its head-specific per-criterion verdicts. - note: Exercise limit: sandbox has no gh auth. 11. **quality `acceptance-prompt-eval`** - command: `git show HEAD:evidence/2026-10-19-role-probes.md | grep -F 'says to run nothing'; git show HEAD:docs/future.md | grep -F 'Supervisor, QC then review'` - output: `The prompt asks for its next actions and their commands, and says to run nothing. A probe shows how the role text reads to a model. It is weaker than a live chain like block 3, and is no substitute for the owed eval cases in 'docs/future.md'. - Supervisor, QC then review on one head (audit F02, docs [...]` - why: class: non-live-smoke-evidence. The supervisor contract change has an owed eval, but its cited smoke explicitly asks the agent to run nothing rather than exercising QC then review. - note: Related to just qa stub (owed evals wait for just qa); the fail itself is the cited smoke not being live. 12. **quality `acceptance-finding-class`** - command: `state=$(scripts/octo-feather-state); printf 'lane_state=%s\nHERDR_PANE_ID=%s\n' "$state" "${HERDR_PANE_ID:-}"; test -d "$state/lanes" && find "$state/lanes" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.handoffs.jsonl' -print || printf 'No lane records or handoffs.jsonl availab [...]` - output: `lane_state=/tmp/gh15-state/octo-feather/sessions/qc-sandbox HERDR_PANE_ID= No lane records or handoffs.jsonl available` - why: class: unexercised-verdict-delivery. No supervisor pane or lane log is available, and this QC run forbids messaging, so delivery and reuse of existing finding classes could not be exercised. - note: Exercise limit: sandbox lane state is empty and QC forbids messaging. 13. **quality `acceptance-decision-log-schema`** - command: `t=$(mktemp -d /tmp/quality-schema.XXXXXX); r=$(mktemp -d /tmp/quality-resources.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$t" "$r"' EXIT; git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$t"; git -C "$t" init -q; git -C "$t" add .; printf '%s\n' '{"ts":"2026-10-19T00:00:00Z","agent":"implementer", [...]` - output: `decisions.jsonl:1 omits why missing_why_gate_exit=0 spec-status: ok (7 status files) templates: ok (2) just check: ok` - why: class: missing-decision-log-validation. The gate accepts a tracked decision log missing why; no decision-log location or schema check is wired into the gate. 14. **remote `acceptance-signed-in`** - command: `printf 'Owner-authenticated review attempt (no owner cookie available):\n'; curl --resolve octo-feather.exe.xyz:7400:161.210.93.204 -sS -L --max-time 30 https://octo-feather.exe.xyz:7400/octo-feather/docs/specs/remote.spec.html | grep -E '|Sign in to co [...]` - output: `Owner-authenticated review attempt (no owner cookie available): <title>Access required

Sign in to continue.

` - why: No authenticated owner browser session available; could not exercise signed-in loading or verify Accept spec controls. - note: Exercise limit: owner-held (exe.dev owner session). 15. **remote `acceptance-stays-private`** - command: `ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null exe.dev share show octo-feather` - output: `exedev@exe.dev: Permission denied (publickey,keyboard-interactive).` - why: exe.dev admin authentication unavailable; could not inspect Private mode, share links or added users, or exercise a setup change. - note: Exercise limit: owner-held (exe.dev admin). 16. **remote `acceptance-after-logout`** - command: `printf 'Current SSH sessions:\n'; ps -eo args | grep '^sshd:'; printf '\nReview after zero current SSH sessions:\n'; curl --resolve octo-feather.exe.xyz:7400:161.210.93.204 -sS -L --max-time 30 https://octo-feather.exe.xyz:7400/octo-feather/docs/specs/remote.s [...]` - output: `Current SSH sessions: sshd: /exe.dev/bin/sshd -D -e -f /exe.dev/etc/ssh/sshd_config [listener] 0 of 1000-1000 startups Review after zero current SSH sessions: Access required

Sign in to continue.

Local registered spec: Remote host and review hos [...]` - why: Service served the registered spec with no active SSH sessions, but owner-authenticated review after an observed logout transition could not be exercised. - note: Exercise limit: owner-held (authenticated review after logout). 17. **remote `acceptance-after-reboot`** - command: `printf 'Boot preflight only, no shared VM reboot authorized:\n'; uptime -s; systemctl --user is-enabled spec-chat-review.service; loginctl show-user exedev -p Linger; printf '\nRegistered spec before any induced reboot:\n'; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:7400/octo [...]` - output: `Boot preflight only, no shared VM reboot authorized: 2026-10-18 20:25:24 enabled Linger=yes Registered spec before any induced reboot: <title>Remote host and review hosting - octo-feather spec` - why: Required induced reboot not performed: shared VM is outside permitted throwaway resources; enabled service and linger do not prove post-reboot loading. - note: Exercise limit: induced VM reboot not permitted on the shared box. 18. **remote `acceptance-vm-only`** - command: `herdr --session default api snapshot` - output: `agents: director (pi, /home/exedev/src/octo-feather, w2:p2); gh15 (pi, /home/exedev/src/octo-feather-gh15, wA:p2) tabs: director (w2); supervisor (wA)` - why: Live VM session showed director and lane supervisor, but owner SSH access and absence of factory agents on the owner's laptop could not be verified. - note: Exercise limit: owner SSH and laptop not observable. Run 6 sandbox escape: judge read the live session snapshot with `herdr --session default` (read-only; no mutation in the live log). 19. **remote `acceptance-no-url-in-records`** - command: `printf 'Issue/PR public CLI read preflight (no shared records mutated):\n'; gh pr view 15 --json number,title,body,url; gh issue view 15 --json number,title,body,url` - output: `To get started with GitHub CLI, please run: gh auth login Alternatively, populate the GH_TOKEN environment variable with a GitHub API authentication token. Command exited with code 4.` - why: GitHub authentication unavailable; no supervisor issue/PR creation or edit exercised, and shared record mutations are prohibited. - note: Exercise limit: sandbox has no gh auth; shared records not mutated. No failure involved herdr wake (deferred, docs/future.md); comms and issue-lifecycle are phase B. Full judge output: `~/.local/state/octo-feather/qc/gh15-/.json`.
